name: Andhra Pesarattu with Ginger Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup whole green moong, rinsed and soaked 4–6 hours
steps: Drain soaked moong and rice. Blend with ginger, chilli, cumin, coriander, salt and enough water to make a smooth, pourable batter.
Heat a seasoned tawa over medium-high. Lightly wipe with oil.
Pour a ladle of batter and spread into a thin circle. Sprinkle with chopped onion.
Cook until the underside is crisp and the top looks dry, about 2–3 minutes. Flip briefly if needed.
Repeat with remaining batter. Serve with ginger chutney; omit ghee to keep it vegan.
note: Traditional Andhra-style green gram dosa. Soaking time is not included in the active preparation estimate.
